keys.malus_points: malus points (per punch on the malus station) (enter a negative value)
keys.late_malus_points: overtime points (per minute over) (enter a negative value)

typography.clickHint: Click a text on the screen to pick its role, then set its size and colour. Every text in that role changes together.
typography.hint: Size is a percentage of the authored size: at 120 % every text in that role grows by the same factor and keeps its proportions.

malusStation.label: Malus station
malusStation.hint: Every punch on this station subtracts the "malus points" above. It cannot be part of the selected pattern.
malusStation.pickerHint: One station only. Stations used by the pattern are disabled.
malusStation.pickerError: Could not load the station inventory.
malusStation.usedByPattern: Already used by the selected pattern
malusStation.unknownSelected: Station #{{id}} is no longer in the inventory.
malusStation.conflict: Malus station #{{id}} is also used by the selected pattern. One punch cannot both complete a quest piece and cost points.

pattern.label: Default Quest pattern (quest images → station mapping)
pattern.hint: Assigns each quest's four piece images to stations/balises. Create Quest patterns in the Patterns page. The mapping is shown next to each image below. Overridable at launch.
pattern.collisionRefused: "{{pattern}}" uses station #{{id}}, which is set as the malus station. Pattern not applied.
pattern.collisionCurrent: The selected pattern uses station #{{id}}, which is set as the malus station.
pattern.collisionFixAndApply: Remove the malus station and apply this pattern

productTemplate.notice: <0>Product template:</0> the "use default images/texts" toggles from the legacy editor are not yet ported. They will return in a follow-up; for now create new Quest scenarios from scratch.

quests.mainImageHint: The complete picture revealed when all 4 pieces are found
quests.soundHint: Played when the quest is completed
quests.fourImages: Four images to find <1>- each forms one quadrant of the main image</1>
quests.overCapWarning_one: This scenario has {{total}} quests but Quest now supports a maximum of {{max}}. The extra {{count}} quest will be removed when you save. Delete unwanted quests to choose which ones are kept.
quests.overCapWarning_other: This scenario has {{total}} quests but Quest now supports a maximum of {{max}}. The extra {{count}} quests will be removed when you save. Delete unwanted quests to choose which ones are kept.

images.downloadDefault: Download default template (use as a spec for custom artwork)
images.customTemplateHint: Custom template must be a 16:9 PNG with a transparent background. Text positions (timer, score, malus, combo, quest list) stay fixed - align your artwork to the downloadable default template.
images.errTooLarge: File is too large ({{mb}} MB). Max 5 MB.
images.errNotPng: Template must be a PNG (with transparent background).
images.errOpaque: Template must have a transparent background (all four corners look opaque).

sounds.hint: A slot left empty stays silent. The per-quest sound is set quest by quest in the Quests section; it plays when the quest's complete picture appears.

triggers.cheating_sound: Plays when a card is rejected for cheating (punches vanished or were replaced since the previous read), together with the on-screen message.
triggers.malus_sound: Plays when the team punched the malus station, as the "malus" counter climbs on screen.
triggers.late_malus_sound: Plays when overtime points are charged (game time exceeded), as the "overtime" counter climbs on screen.
